audit_items.proof_trace: The property asserts that block.header.commitment_count must equal len(block.blob_kzg_commitments), but the Ethereum beacon chain BeaconBlockHeader structure does not contain a commitment_count field. The header only contains slot, proposer_index, parent_root, state_root, and body_root (proto/prysm/v1alpha1/beacon_core_types.proto:20-41). The blob_kzg_commitments field exists in the BeaconBlockBody, not the header, and there is no separate count field to validate against. The implementation validates len(blob_kzg_commitments) <= MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK (payload.go:238-240), but this is a different invariant than the one stated in the property.
